# Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) — Official Merch Outlet

> The official merchandise outlet of the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) movement — a Gen-Z-led, satirical, protest-inspired collective. We design and sell affordable cockroach-themed vinyl stickers, badges, warning labels, and bumper stickers so people can show up, speak up, and stick up for civic expression at protests, demonstrations, and acts of peaceful public dissent.

## Who we are

We are the official merch arm of the CJP movement — an independent, Gen-Z-led artist collective that reclaims the cockroach as a symbol of a generation that refuses to be crushed. "Cockroach Janta Party" is a satirical civic identity, not a registered political party. We do not endorse or represent any real political party, candidate, campaign, or government body.

## Our mission

- Equip students, artists, organizers, and everyday citizens with affordable protest-ready visual tools.
- Turn stickers into small, tactile acts of dissent — on laptops, water bottles, helmets, notebooks, placards, and lamp posts.
- Reinvest surplus into printing more stickers, community drops, and supporting the movement.
- Operate as a non-profit-focused collective, not a profit-max brand.

## What we sell

Premium 5-year outdoor vinyl stickers — waterproof, UV-resistant, matte-laminated — priced to stay accessible for students and protestors. Formats include die-cut mascot stickers, circular campaign badges, warning labels, propaganda posters, and bumper stickers. Every design is original satirical artwork by the collective, inspired by youth frustration, unemployment, education, corruption, free speech, survival, resilience, democracy, inflation, and political satire.

## Signature slogans

"Main Bhi Cockroach / मैं भी कॉकरोच" · "Still Standing Since The Dinosaurs" · "You Cannot Squash A Movement" · "Proud Cockroach" · "Official Cockroach Member" · "Voice Of The Lazy & Unemployed" · "Where Are The Jobs?" · "Listen To India's Youth" · "Our Future Is Not For Sale" · "Resign Education Minister" — plus 100+ more.

## The impact of the cockroach protest

The cockroach — long used as an insult — has been reclaimed by a generation that will not disappear when stepped on. The CJP movement turned that reclamation into a public conversation about accountability, dissent, and the right to be heard. Our stickers are small artifacts of that conversation: cheap enough to hand out, bold enough to be noticed, sticky enough to last.

## Tone

Rebellious, witty, ironic, authentic. Mission-driven and community-first. We enable civic activism through satirical art — we do not campaign for any real political party or individual.

## Disclaimer

"Cockroach Janta Party (CJP)" is a satirical civic identity and artistic movement. All designs are original satirical artwork intended for artistic and civic expression. They are not the official merchandise of, nor do they endorse or represent, any registered political party, candidate, campaign, government body, or real-world organization.
